message.content:
Based on the provided UI mockup, here is an exhaustive, pixel-level description of the **ELD Trip Planner** interface, structured for high-fidelity reconstruction.

### 1. Overall Layout & Screen Type
*   **Screen Type:** A dense, data-rich dashboard (web application style) utilizing a split-pane layout.
*   **Structure:**
    *   **Header:** Fixed top navigation bar.
    *   **Sub-Header:** Trip summary bar with KPIs and compliance status.
    *   **Alert Banner:** Full-width warning strip below the sub-header.
    *   **Main Content Area:** Divided into two primary columns:
        *   **Left Column (~30% width):** "Stops & Rests Itinerary" vertical timeline/accordion.
        *   **Right Column (~70% width):** Interactive Map view with floating telemetry widgets.
    *   **Footer:** Status bar at the very bottom.

---

### 2. Top App Bar Contents
*   **Background:** White (`#FFFFFF`).
*   **Left Side:**
    *   **Logo Icon:** Small truck icon inside a square box.
    *   **App Title:** "**ELD Trip Planner**" (Bold, Sans-serif, Dark Grey/Black).
    *   **Navigation Tabs:** Pill-shaped buttons or text links:
        1.  "**Route Planner**" (Active state: Light Blue background `#E3F2FD`, Blue text, rounded corners).
        2.  "HOS Logs"
        3.  "FMCSA Compliance"
        4.  "Manifest"
*   **Right Side (Status Chips & Profile):**
    *   **Cycle Chip:** Orange dot + "**70hr / 8-day cycle**" (Light grey background pill).
    *   **Help Link:** Info icon (i) + "**How it works**".
    *   **User Profile:** Avatar circle (Dark) + Name "**James Carter**" + ID "**IL-TRK-4471**" in smaller text below name.

---

### 3. Sub-Header (Trip Manifest Bar)
*   **Background:** Deep Navy Blue/Dark Slate (`#1A237E` or similar). Text is White.
*   **Metadata (Top Left, small caps):** "**TRIP MANIFEST • OCT 4, 2026 • ELD-ID #99420-IL**".
*   **Route Title (Large):** Truck Icon + "**Chicago, IL → Joliet, IL → Detroit, MI**".
*   **KPI Badges (Inline):**
    *   Ruler Icon: "**DISTANCE: 282 mi**"
    *   Clock Icon: "**EST. DRIVING: 5h 20m**"
    *   Calendar Icon: "**LOGS: 2 Days**"
*   **Status Actions (Right Side):**
    *   Checkmark Badge: "**Compliant**" (White text on Green/Dark bg).
    *   Warning Badge: Triangle icon + "**HOS Advisory**" (Yellow/Orange accent).
    *   Button: Download Icon + "**Export PDF**" (White button, dark text).

---

### 4. Alert Banner
*   **Background:** Light Peach/Orange (`#FFF3E0`).
*   **Icon:** Warning Triangle (Orange outline).
*   **Text:** "**FMCSA HOS Advisory:** This route profile requires a mandatory 34-hour restart before Day 3 if continuing interstate transit. An off-duty sleeper berth rest is pre-allocated at GM Assembly Yard."
*   **Action:** 'X' close icon on the far right.

---

### 5. Left Panel: Waypoint Sequence ("Stops & Rests Itinerary")
*   **Container:** White card with subtle shadow/border.
*   **Header:** "**WAYPOINT SEQUENCE**" (Small, grey, uppercase). Title: "**Stops & Rests Itinerary**". Badge: "**5 Stops Total**" (Blue pill).
*   **Timeline List (Vertical Line):**
    *   A solid dark grey line connects circular numbered nodes vertically.
    *   **Node 1 (Origin):**
        *   **Circle:** Black fill, White number "**1**".
        *   **Time:** "**08:00 CDT**" (Bold).
        *   **Badge:** "**ORIGIN**" (Blue/Grey outline).
        *   **Title:** "**Midwest Regional Yard**".
        *   **Subtext:** "Chicago, IL • Terminal Ramp 4B".
        *   **Meta:** "🚛 Drive: 45m • 42 mi ⏱️ (15 min) • Mile 0.0".
    *   **Node 2 (Pickup):**
        *   **Circle:** Orange/Yellow fill, Black number "**2**".
        *   **Time:** "**08:45 – 09:45 CDT**".
        *   **Badge:** "**PICKUP**" (Orange background, white text).
        *   **Title:** "**Amazon Fulfillment MDW2**".
        *   **Subtext:** "Joliet, IL • Dock Door 82".
        *   **Meta:** "Drive: 2h 15m • 128 mi 🕒 1h On-Duty Dwell • 34,200 lbs".
    *   **Node 3 (Break):**
        *   **Circle:** Light Blue fill, Black number "**3**".
        *   **Time:** "**12:00 – 12:30 EDT**".
        *   **Badge:** "**HOS BREAK**" (Blue background).
        *   **Title:** "**Oasis Travel Plaza**".
        *   **Subtext:** "LaPorte, IN • I-94 Exit 39".
        *   **Meta:** "Drive: 1h 00m • 54 mi 🛌 30min Off-Duty Rest Complied".
    *   **Node 4 (Fuel):**
        *   **Circle:** Brown/Gold fill, Black number "**4**".
        *   **Time:** "**13:30 – 13:45 EDT**".
        *   **Badge:** "**FUEL STOP**" (Brown background).
        *   **Title:** "**Pilot Travel Center #418**".
        *   **Subtext:** "Kalamazoo, MI • Mile Marker 78".
        *   **Meta:** "Drive: 1h 20m • 58 mi ⛽ 120 Gallons Added".
    *   **Node 5 (Destination):**
        *   **Circle:** Dark Navy fill, Flag icon instead of number.
        *   **Time:** "**15:05 – 16:05 EDT**".
        *   **Badge:** "**DESTINATION**" (Navy background).
        *   **Title:** "**GM Assembly & Logistics**".
        *   **Subtext:** "Detroit, MI • Gate 7 Inbound".
        *   **Meta:** "PO-4899120 • Unload • End of Day 1 Operations".

*   **Legend (Bottom of Panel):**
    *   Header: "**DUTY STATUS LEGEND**".
    *   Items: Black Dot "Driving", Orange Dot "On-Duty", Blue Dot "Off-Duty".

---

### 6. Right Panel: Map Interface
*   **Map Background:**
    *   Light blue/grey vector map showing the Great Lakes region (Lake Michigan visible).
    *   **Route Line:** Thick black line with orange/yellow highlight (looks like a highway shield style).
    *   **Markers:** Numbered pins (1-5) corresponding to the left panel, placed geographically on the route.
    *   **Labels:** City names like "Gary, IN", "LaPorte, IN", "Kalamazoo", "IL", "IN", "MI".
    *   **Active Nav Tooltip:** Floating white bubble near start point: "**ACTIVE NAV CORRIDOR • I-94 E • Real-time Telemetry**".
*   **Map Controls (Floating Right):**
    *   Vertical toolbar with: Plus (+), Minus (-), Compass target, Layers diamond, Fullscreen expand.
*   **Map Stats (Top Right of Map Area):**
    *   Small text line: Orange dot "Avg Ground Speed: 53.4 mph", Fuel pump "Fuel Burn Rate: 6.8 mpg", Cloud "Corridor WX: Clear 54°F".

---

### 7. Floating Widgets (Overlaid on Map)
*   **Widget A: Driver HOS Telemetry (Bottom Right Overlay)**
    *   **Style:** White card, shadow, rounded corners.
    *   **Header:** Clock icon + "**Driver HOS Telemetry**". Right align: "**US 49 CFR §395**".
    *   **Row 1:** Label "**Driving Today:**" | Value "**5h 20m / 11h**".
        *   Progress bar: Orange fill (~48%).
        *   Sub-text: "5h 40m remaining".
    *   **Row 2:** Label "**14h On-Duty Window:**" | Value "**8h 05m / 14h**".
        *   Progress bar: Dark Blue fill (~58%).
        *   Sub-text: "5h 55m remaining".
    *   **Row 3:** Label "**70h / 8-Day Cycle:**" | Value "**43.1h / 70h**" (Orange text).
        *   Progress bar: Brown/Gold fill (~61%).
        *   Sub-text: "26.9h available cycle".

*   **Widget B: Live Unit Tracker (On Map Route)**
    *   Black tooltip attached to a truck icon on the highway line near Kalamazoo.
    *   Text: "**UNIT 4471 • 62 MPH**".
    *   Speed limit sign icon showing "94" (likely km/h context or specific zone).

---

### 8. Bottom Dashboard Cards (Below Map)
Three distinct cards spanning the width:
1.  **Selected Corridor:**
    *   Icon: Road/Shield.
    *   Title: "**SELECTED CORRIDOR**".
    *   Data: "**I-94 Tollway / Hwy 12**".
    *   Sub: "All CMV Toll Passes Sync'd".
2.  **Break Rule Compliance:**
    *   Icon: Timer/Clock.
    *   Title: "**BREAK RULE COMPLIANCE**".
    *   Data: "**30-Min Rest Logged**".
    *   Sub: "At 3.75h elapsed driving window".
3.  **ELD Hardware Status:**
    *   Icon: Device/Tablet.
    *   Title: "**ELD HARDWARE STATUS**".
    *   Data: "**Garmin eLog #IL-994**".
    *   Sub: "ECM Stream Stable • 0 Malfunctions".

---

### 9. Footer
*   **Background:** White/Light Grey.
*   **Left:** Blue dot + "**Telematics Engine v4.19 • US FMCSA 49 CFR Part 395 Verified**".
*   **Right:** "© 2024 ELD Trip Planner SaaS. All operational telematics rights reserved."

---

### 10. Visual Design System (Style Guide)
*   **Colors:**
    *   **Primary:** Royal/Navy Blue (`#2962FF` range).
    *   **Secondary/Accent:** Amber/Orange (`#FF6D00`) used for driving/pickup alerts.
    *   **Success:** Green (`#00C853`).
    *   **Warning:** Yellow/Orange (`#FFAB00`).
    *   **Backgrounds:** White cards on very light grey (`#F5F5F5`) page background.
*   **Typography:**
    *   **Headings:** Bold, Sans-Serif (likely Inter or Roboto), Dark Slate.
    *   **Data/Numbers:** Monospaced or Tabular numbers for alignment (e.g., times, distances).
    *   **Labels:** Uppercase, small size (10-11px), wide letter spacing, medium grey.
*   **Spacing:**
    *   Dense information density.
    *   Cards have consistent padding (approx 16px - 24px).
    *   Timeline items have generous vertical padding (approx 16px gap between nodes).

### 11. Sample Data Summary
*   **Driver:** James Carter (IL-TRK-4471).
*   **Route:** Chicago -> Joliet -> Detroit.
*   **Date:** Oct 4, 2026.
*   **Stats:** 282 miles, 5h 20m drive time, 2 Days logging.
*   **Compliance:** Currently Compliant, but HOS Advisory active regarding Day 3 restart.
